summary_paragraph: A man with end-stage renal disease on hemodialysis, type II diabetes, and heart failure was admitted due to a thrombosed right brachiobasilic fistula. He underwent a successful thrombectomy and balloon angioplasty to restore blood flow, with residual stenosis noted in the central vein. He received a dialysis session during admission and was stabilized on his home medications. The interventional radiology team expressed concern about recurrent stenosis and will schedule a follow-up procedure within two weeks. He was discharged home in stable condition with instructions to resume dialysis, monitor blood glucose, and watch for fistula function.
problems: Chronic systolic and diastolic heart failure
Diabetes mellitus type II with neuropathy
